subject: Slate prioritization & offer routing — runtime kernel SRE slots
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Rita Gomez <rita@vertextalent.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Slate prioritization & offer routing — runtime kernel SRE slots

Team —

Following up from the staffing sync: we have five open kernel-SRE slots in the Q4 runtime slate but only capacity to extend three senior offers this cycle if we keep current budget headroom. I attached the runtime_slate_q4.csv with the current priority scores (tech fit, ramp time, IC depth).

Two asks:
- Can we agree on a prioritized order for the three approvals (senior vs mid)? I recommend we prioritize candidates with ownership on KV cache and quantization experience.
- Who will own routing offers to external agencies vs direct (internal referrals)? Rita from Vertex is copied and has two green candidates ready for offer.

Notes:
- If we bump one mid-level to a senior band, it will need an exception sign-off (comp band exception).
- We may be able to convert a contractor (infra-ctr-12) to full-time instead of filling an external role — that changes headcount math.

Attaching: runtime_slate_q4.csv

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Manager, Kernel & Runtime
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: runtime_slate_q4.csv (csv, 52KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Slate prioritization & offer routing — runtime kernel SRE slots

Thanks Jasmine — good primer. Quick reactions:

1) Prioritization: agree on senior hires for candidates A and B (both strong KV/cache + quantization). Candidate C is borderline senior — we should hold as mid unless Marcus can make a clear case on ramp velocity.
2) Routing: Vertex can handle 1 offer (Priya) given their candidate quality, but we should reserve the second to internal referrals to keep cost down.
3) Band exception: if Marcus wants to push C to senior, we need a short justification doc and a comp-band exception request to People Ops.

Ask Marcus and Karthik to weigh in on the contractor conversion option. If we convert infra-ctr-12, we free a junior slot but consume a senior FTE equivalent in budget modeling.

-Kimberly
VP, Talent & Org Planning
Redwood Inference

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-10T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Slate prioritization & offer routing — runtime kernel SRE slots

Thanks — I reviewed the slate. A couple additional data points:

- Candidate C actually has prior work shipping quantized transformer kernels at scale (resume note). My hesitation was their lack of distributed-systems ownership; with a 30% onboarding plan they can be ready for the core KV ownership in 10-12 weeks.
- Converting infra-ctr-12 to FTE looks budget-neutral for Q1 if we move their cost from contractor line to headcount and defer a junior hire. That would give us three senior-level contributions without increasing the overall commitment this quarter.

Proposal:
1) Approve senior offers for Candidate A and Priya Singh (via Vertex) now.
2) Approve Candidate C as senior contingent on Marcus-led onboarding plan (deliverable: 30/60/90 ramp with measurable milestones).
3) Convert infra-ctr-12 to FTE and re-route the junior slot to the mid-level candidate on the slate.

I've attached a quick band_swap_matrix.xlsx that maps current comp bands to the proposed swaps and the expected OTE delta. If Karthik and Kim sign off, I'll draft the comp justification for People Ops.

Marcus
Director, Runtime Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: band_swap_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)

Date: 2026-12-10T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Slate prioritization & offer routing — runtime kernel SRE slots

Jasmine / team —

Thanks for the quick sync. I can confirm Priya Singh is available to accept an offer with a two-week notice. I've attached a candidate_offer_summary.pdf with references and comp expectations. If you want Vertex to run the initial verbal and written offer, I can route and collect the signed acceptance to speed the process.

If you approve routing Priya via Vertex, please confirm the target base and sign-on range and whether you want Vertex to pre-clear relocation or remote-first.

Best,
Rita Gomez
Senior Recruiter, Vertex Talent

Date: 2026-12-10T17:45:00-08:00
Subject: Final: Slate prioritization & offer routing — runtime kernel SRE slots

Team —

Thanks for the clear proposals. Approvals below (summary + next steps):

1) Approve senior offers for Candidate A and Priya Singh (Vertex) — proceed with offers. Target comp: match band 5 midpoint; sign-on within approved budget band.
2) Candidate C to be approved as senior contingent on Marcus delivering the 30/60/90 onboarding plan within three business days; People Ops will treat this as a comp-band exception (I authorize submission).
3) Approve conversion of infra-ctr-12 to FTE; finance to reconcile in the Q1 reforecast.

Action items:
- Marcus: upload the onboarding plan and comp justification to the drive link and ping People Ops (cc Kim).
- Jasmine: confirm the Priya offer details to Rita so Vertex can run the offer.
- Kim: route comp-band exception paperwork through People Ops with the attached band_swap_matrix.xlsx.

I'll note this approval under HC-RT-2026-07 and mark the slate as "approved for routing". If any of these items change materially, escalate to me directly.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Platform & Runtime
Redwood Inference
